intro: A Dynamite Plan is a task offered by the inventive tinkerer Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind's Dwarven District. Excited by talk of industrial sabotage, she seeks a sizable stash of coarse dynamite to kick-start the plan. Adventurers must manufacture or acquire the munitions to support her scheming.
